scan_skipped_tests: scan model tests for overridden or skipped common test methods across all HuggingFace models
summarize_single_test: summarize skip status of a single test method across all model implementations
build_model_overrides: build a mapping of model names to their test function skip status and reasons
extract_test_info: extract test function names, skip status, and skip reasons from a test file's decorators
get_common_tests: get common test function names and their origin from shared test files
